name: judge-against-criteria
description: Use for classification or filtering governed by explicit criteria. Check the evidence, including current versus resolved conditions.
---

Read each item's actual evidence and the exact criterion. Distinguish current conditions from historical, repaired, hypothetical or requested conditions. A repaired problem is not automatically a feature request; neither may satisfy an active-problem criterion. Determine what would make the label true and what evidence defeats it. Do not classify solely by a keyword or invent unseen fields. Use false when the criterion is not met; do not call a negative judgment blocked. Compute the final filtered set and its keys from completed judgments in eval. Delegate useful semantic work when needed, and reuse its results.

For one completed calculation, eval with finish:true returns its final expression or top-level return immediately. Semantic choices may require judgment; bookkeeping over those choices must be exact.

files.select_skill.nl:
---
args:
  task: "unknown"
  policy: "string"
  candidates: "Record<string, SkillPlan>"
returns: "SkillPlan"
---
Select the useful next skill using the task, history, already-loaded list and skill descriptions. Formulate an inline question from the runtime objective. This invocation selects the next skill; do not execute the task objective. Return the supplied chosen candidate record unchanged (including description and next_step), and read its bound skill with read_code before finishing unless none is selected. The candidates include a record whose id is none: select and return that exact record when no new skill is useful; never substitute null or a blocked outcome for it.
files.types.ts: export type SkillPlan = { id: string; description: string; next_step: string };
files.select_skill/skills/judge-against-criter:
---
name: judge-against-criteria
description: Use for classification or filtering governed by explicit criteria. Check the evidence, including current versus resolved conditions.
---

Read each item's actual evidence and the exact criterion. Distinguish current conditions from historical, repaired, hypothetical or requested conditions. A repaired problem is not automatically a feature request; neither may satisfy an active-problem criterion. Determine what would make the label true and what evidence defeats it. Do not classify solely by a keyword or invent unseen fields. Use false when the criterion is not met; do not call a negative judgment blocked. Compute the final filtered set and its keys from completed judgments in eval. Delegate useful semantic work when needed, and reuse its results.
files.select_skill/skills/calculate-from-data/:
---
name: calculate-from-data
description: Use for exact arithmetic, counts, sorting or aggregation of supplied records. Calculate in eval and return the computed value.
---

Use eval with the actual bound inputs or retrieved records. Do not recreate data from memory. Cover all pages when inputs are paged. Compute the requested formula, counts and keys in code. Expressions belong inside eval code; tool arguments contain literal values, not unevaluated arithmetic. Return a computed number or record, not a string containing code. For one completed calculation, eval with finish:true returns its final expression or top-level return immediately. Semantic choices may require judgment; bookkeeping over those choices must be exact.
files.select_skill/skills/move-and-verify-file:
---
name: move-and-verify-files
description: Use when files must be moved or archived. Move source handles and verify the destination tree.
---

Identify the source path and destination before a write. Move the SOURCE handle: await folder.file("inbox/a.md").moveTo(folder.dir("archive")); then inspect folder.file("archive/a.md") and folder.diff(). Handles retain their original paths after moving; reacquire a handle at the destination. Do not move a handle already taken from the destination into that same destination. If several files qualify, finish all required changes and return precisely the requested value. Preserve unrelated files. Verify both the final tree and the return value.
